data.title: 阿尔法 · 晨光窗台的领带系理
data.description: 晨光熹微的华贵公寓卧室内，阿尔法踩着柔软地毯微踮脚尖，白皙指尖轻柔地为眼前的少年整理领带与衣领，唇角含着沉静而全心托付的温柔浅笑。
data.location: luxurious sun-drenched private suite bedroom beside tall sheer-curtained windows
data.action: standing close, gentle hands adjusting partner's necktie and shirt collar, tiptoeing slightly, serene adoring blue eyes, soft affectionate smile
data.lighting: warm diffused morning sunbeams glowing through white sheer curtains
data.mood: mature domestic bliss, serene devoted love, tender morning intimacy
data.promptProse: In a sunlit private bedroom, elegant blonde elf Alpha gently straightens the partner's necktie with slender fingers, gazing up with deep serene devotion as morning light warms the room.
data.animaCaption: Standing close in the morning window light, she tenderly adjusts the necktie with a serene adoring smile.
